chunks: He brought out its water and its pastures from it,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God brings out the water and pastures of the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a reference to the subterranean sources of water and the natural fertility of the earth, emphasizing God's continuous provision (rizq) through hidden mechanisms. It underscores the divine authority over the earth's resources, serving as a sign for those who reflect on the balance of nature and the sustenance provided to all creatures.
